scope: Home and Projects; native scroll; screenshots and device mockups remain static

homeEntrance.rootCause: Scroll beyond 24 px, pointerdown and keydown called finish(interrupted); a second scrollY check skipped initialization after font loading.
homeEntrance.fix: Removed scroll/input cancellation and the asynchronous scroll-position guard. Height-only viewport changes no longer cancel the entrance. Canvas fragments live inside the transformed name; entrance owns opacity/individual translate, depth owns transform.
remainingCancellation: actual viewport width change invalidating glyph dimensions
homeEntrance.verification: Early scroll at 200, 500, 1000, 1500 ms at 1440, 768, 390 px; fast scroll, reload, keyboard, touch pointer and viewport-height change; all completed normally.

effects.intent: Atmosphere lingers while a lateral warm/cool field crosses behind the crisp heading. No pinning or artificial scroll runway.

effects.progress: q = clamp((0.94 * viewportHeight - recentViewportTop) / (0.48 * viewportHeight), 0, 1); first line clamp(q/0.78), second line clamp((q-0.16)/0.84)
effects.transforms: Paper cap translateY 72→0 px (50.4→0 at <=800 px). First line enters its clip from x=-36 px/y=125%; second x=36 px/y=125%. Both finish at 0/0. Description only opacity, q=0.4→1.
effects.intent: The paper edge advances across the gradient; staggered, reversible masks resolve the editorial title before the gallery. No timed IntersectionObserver reveal on Recent Work.

effects.intent: Environmental texture moves behind stationary product UI; cool blue Chatra, cream/mint Söyle, deep-blue Urpaq, graphite FreelanceOS.

effects.transforms: Paper y=108p px; name y=36p px; orange frame y=-24p px; mint/yellow/peach/blue stickers y=[-44,-28,32,-38]*p px plus restrained desktop pointer offsets. Multiply scroll travel by 0.55 at <=600 px.
effects.intent: Four depth planes, with the canvas and native name sharing a single coordinate system throughout the entrance.
